issue_context.title: topsql: try to reduce Plan Not Available

review_comments: Yes, this can reduce the pressure on the `repoter` behind.
Is this reasonable? Do we have only two `Plans` for the same `SQL`?

No, but We can only remove the `""` plan when there are only 1 valid plan, so the `len(plans) == 2` is a filter to filter the SQL which `len(plans) == 2` and next filter use to filter at least 1 plan is `""` plan.
